workload_description: Existing world_entry_frames.gd: real account, first roster card equals requested character, stationary post-entry camera, pending object queue drains, then 60–300 seconds settled sampling. MAIN supplies server availability; runner does not start or mutate server.

required_inputs.workload: Account/character identity (no passwords), map/position, roster ordering, scene, observation duration and fixture revision/hash.
required_inputs.assets: Frozen content/build/resolver identity and relevant asset-set fingerprints. Hash concrete captured inventory via input_paths; never delete, warm or rewrite caches implicitly.
required_inputs.options: Exact persisted options snapshot hash plus actual effective graphics/cap/vsync/sound/resolution settings. Supply snapshot path in input_paths; no user settings mutation.
required_inputs.cache: Observed pre-run warm/cold state, import state, OS page cache condition (unknown if not established), loader/cache identity; do not equate two warm labels without matching contents/procedure.
required_inputs.hardware_driver: GPU/device, driver, CPU, RAM, power/clocks, compositor/display driver and host; note agents.slice contention. Host uname is auto-recorded, not GPU/clock proof.
required_inputs.renderer: API and equivalent rendering configuration, not equal engine names; expected Bevy/Godot implementation differences recorded in each build provenance.
required_inputs.server_state: Existing private endpoint, server revision/state snapshot and availability supplied by MAIN. No restart/mutation by runner. Workload server activity may alter state: record that limit.
required_inputs.camera: Initial/final position/orientation, FOV, stationary/controlled route and requested character. No native JS/IPC edits or additional camera control supplied by this runner.
required_inputs.sampling: Equal startup boundary, EnterWorld-to-InWorld boundary, queue drain condition, 60–300 second settled wall-clock process-frame interval method; nearest-rank percentiles. Original Bevy baseline without these boundaries is a comparison gap.
required_inputs.resource_limits: agent-run slice/cgroup limits, other concurrent workloads, renderer/display resolution, cap and vsync. User disabled hardware/services remain disabled.
required_inputs.input_paths: Map names to real files: Godot executable, native extension .so, fixture, captured options/cache/asset inventories. SHA256 before/after is auto-recorded; no placeholder paths provided.
required_inputs.build_provenance: Separate root launcher/legacy binary and native extension source revisions, exact compiled scope/profile, build ID/log and artifact hash. Observed git HEAD does not establish built source. Root build is not native build proof. Unknown/unused scopes explicit.

proof_limits: Null fields are unanswered inputs, not measured state. No retained matching original baseline yet. Native measurements alone are not parity. VmHWM is process lifetime high-water; VmRSS phase observations are not leak/growth/shutdown proof. Numeric frame limits remain fixture policy.
